children.value: > Fact From Story: Quarterback Geno Smith's completion percentage was down from 2022 (69.8 to 65.4 percent) despite the impressive offensive weapons around him.
> > Fact From Story: Seattle has an out in his contract after this season that would only carry a $17.4 million dead-cap number, per Spotrac.
> > > Fact From Story: Geno Smith did OK completing passes last week when pressured (60% completion rate) but not at an efficient level (5.4 yards per attempt).
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Quarterbacks are expected to perform well under pressure, completing passes efficiently.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Teams are more likely to move on from players who are underperforming and have contract clauses that make it easier to do so.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A lower completion percentage indicates a decline in performance for a quarterback.
